text:
kevin: heads-up, customers reporting billing spikes this morning, looks correlated with a surge of 502->retry flows through the edge.
irene: saw that on support slack, invoice numbers up ~12% for a subset of accounts. any signal from metering?
sana: digging into ingestion logs now, weirdly a bunch of meter events have unique event_id but identical payloads besides `request_id` header.
maya: the edge generates a new `x-request-id` on each proxy hop when downstream times out; retries to other backend create new ids so dedupe misses them.
kevin: ah — so dedupe key is `event_id` which we set to request_id, but retries change it. that would double/tri-ple count tokens.
alex: confirmed in kafka: same user+session+model+prompt hash but different `event_id` values and identical `tokens` counts.
jorge: sample log snippet:
```
EDGE: proxy timeout -> retry
PayloadHash: 7f3b2c
x-request-id: 01a
x-request-id: 01b
meter_event: {"event_id":"01a","tokens":312}
meter_event: {"event_id":"01b","tokens":312}
```
irene: so the root cause is edge-level id generation + client doesn't set idempotency. dedupe window also tiny (30s), but retries are immediate so still in window — except since ids differ, we don't dedupe.
sana: proposed short-term: change metering-ingest to compute a stable fingerprint if `client_idempotency_key` absent. fingerprint = sha256(prefix_fields) where prefix_fields = user_id + session_cookie_hash + truncated(prompt_hash) + model+route_hint.
kevin: doable, but need to be careful: privacy/hash salt, and collision risk across different requests with same prompt (we'd undercount in that case).
metering-bot: alert: metric spike detected on billing-prod topic, partitions 4-7, investigating.
alex: for now let's scope to retries only: include `edge_retry_count` in event and if >0, compute fingerprint that includes the timestamp bucket (+/- 1s) to avoid coalescing unique successive requests.
jorge: alternative: have edge set `x-global-fingerprint` when it first sees client request: hash(client-id, session, body) and attach on retries. requires edge change but immediate and minimal pipeline impact.
maya: edge change would be safest long-term. rollout plan: patch edge to set fingerprint, backfill pipeline to use `x-global-fingerprint` when present, otherwise fallback to computed fingerprint.
irene: what about dashboards? ops team saw the spike on per-route dashboards — need to mark affected invoices and create credits if threshold exceeded.
kevin: ops: can we run a quick backfill job to detect duplicated groups by (user+time window+tokens) and tag invoice lines as potential dups? if yes, we issue interim credits for accounts with >5% delta.
ops-bot: ticket created: PLAT-6243 "duplicate-meter-events from proxy retries" assigned to eng-platform.
sana: implementation tasks:
- edge: add `x-global-fingerprint` header (sha256(salt + client_id + session+body)) — will PR today
- ingest: accept `global_fingerprint` field, use as dedupe key before falling back to `event_id`
- aggregator: change idempotency to prefer global_fingerprint when present
- backfill: run dedupe scan over last 48hrs for accounts with spikes
- docs: console messaging that we issued credits
kevin: timeline?
alex: edge PR by EOD, ingest + aggregator patch in next deploy window (tomorrow morning), backfill run after that. ops to prepare credit script.
jorge: small note: ensure fingerprinting respects PII rules — use salt from secrets manager and do not log raw values.
maya: tests: unit for fingerprint collision window, integration test simulating 3 retries and confirm single meter write.
irene: also add a debug flag to metering-ingest to emit `dedupe_reason` in logs for a day so SRE can validate.
kevin: customers to notify? support drafted a short blurb offering credits and explaining fix.
ops-bot: support ticket batch prepared: TCK-501..TCK-535
sana: one more thought — sampling for debug users was disabled; re-enable 1% trace sampling to collect full traces for affected invoices.
kevin: agreed. ok team, proceed. :thumbsup:
maya: I'll own edge PR and testing.
alex: I'll do ingest + aggregator.
jorge: I'll run backfill and coordinate with finance on credits.
metering-bot: CI pipeline triggered for edge PR #4827.
kevin: thanks — update in this thread as you progress. :eyes:
